Navigation.entryDescription: Build and manage fight camps in one place.

PublicHome.lead: Track your training, sparring and recovery in one place. Follow your coach's programme, build your own, or get a personalised plan.
PublicHome.benefit1Body: Generate personalised S&C plans or create your own sessions.
PublicHome.benefit2Body: Check in for recovery-based tweaks and customise your workouts.
PublicHome.benefit3Body: Log training and sparring, and explore drills in the library.
PublicHome.tool1Body: A round timer with fight presets, halfway and 10-second warnings.
PublicHome.tool2Body: Log an injury and follow staged rehab alongside your training.
PublicHome.tool3Body: Track bodyweight towards fight night, with a flag on steep cuts.
